blocks.text: Filipino classic rock and pop fans are in for a nostalgic treat as acclaimed singer, songwriter, and bassist Jason Scheff, longtime lead vocalist of legendary rock band Chicago, takes the stage at the Smart Araneta Coliseum on Wednesday, February 10, 2027. Jason joined Chicago in late 1985 upon Cetera’s departure and walked into a virtually impossible scenario. Chicago had come off of their most successful album in their career, Chicago 17, spawning hits such as “You’re The Inspiration” and “Hard Habit To Break”.
